# Mohammad Noor Abu Khlaif — Software Engineer & AI Advocate

Building & leading AI-powered developer platforms. SDE III at Expedia Group (ex-Amazon).
Based in Amman, Jordan. 9+ years of software engineering experience.

Mohammad Noor Abu Khlaif is a Software Development Engineer III who invented EG Wizard —
an AI-powered migration platform that turned weeks-long framework migrations into hours.
Named Expedia Group's first GitHub Copilot Champion (2024) and AI Champion (2026).
